findings.text: The two migrated boxes got visibly bigger. In shots/settings-400-after.png the LivePage.js class box (top) and the page.jsonl file box are about 20px taller than in settings-400-before.png, and their icons and text sit about 15px further right (icon x≈42 vs 25 before). The kit's `.card` padding appears to beat `.live-settings-box { padding: .25rem 0 }` and `.live-files-body { padding: .25rem 0 }` at LivePage.css:26,45, so the "keeps only a sliver top and bottom" intent is not met. Pick a selector or layer that wins, or accept `.card`'s padding and drop the dead declarations, then re-shoot. LayoutCheck can't see this, so only the shots show it.

The requirements ask for before/after shots of both pages at 400 and 1200. shots/ holds only the four `settings-*` pngs. There are none for the second page (the one that shows `LivePage.Files`; the log says `/live/plan/ui-kit/settings/`), and the `is-file` case (a single file's page) was never shot. The `.card` removal in `file()` (LivePage.js:123) is therefore unverified visually.

The "declarations removed and added" count is a named deliverable and is not in session.jsonl; grep finds no such line. A rough count from the diff is about 14 removed and 4 added. Log the exact numbers.

The log has no line saying which settings option was chosen (rows as `.ui-row` inside one `.card`) and why. The requirements say to log it. The code comment at LivePage.js:86 gives a reason, but the task folder doesn't.
Nothing says what happened to `--live-card`, which the requirements ask to log. If only DesignPage.css still uses it, state that.

Settings rows get no divider. `.live-files-row + .live-files-row` (LivePage.css:47) only matches the class row, so the "Card" / "Saved screen" row sits under the class row with no line, while file rows have dividers. Check the settings page still reads as one list.

The ui/row/row.js bug (css() writes to `document.head` with no node guard) is worked around in LivePage.js:21 and filed only in .claude/skills/css/improvements.md:15, a file outside the owned set. It is not fixed in `ui/parts.js` and not noted in `ui/row/readme.md`. The next module that imports a `ui/*` part in a class replayed in node will hit the same silent fallback. Either fix `css()` or add a Watch out line to the ui/row readme.

The row padding changed from `.55em .75rem` to the kit's `.45em .6em`, so list rows are slightly tighter. That is expected from the move to the kit, but it is a visible change worth the owner's glance.
public/live/readme.md was updated in the same diff. The wording is accurate and the `Files.file()` drop of `.card` is documented. No other index gap seen.
